about: Predatory venue list read by scoring.rules.core.PredatoryVenueRule. Ships only entries backed by a public legal or authoritative finding; users extend it. Matching: 'name_regex' (Python, case-insensitive) against venue or publisher name; 'doi_prefixes' against the DOI prefix; 'issn' exact.

entries.note: US District Court for the District of Nevada, FTC v. OMICS Group Inc., summary judgment 2019-03-29.
